acceptanceCriteria: Add a repository gate (local doc gate and CI) that fails on ^<<<<<<< , ^=======$ or ^>>>>>>>  lines in docs/**, *.go, *.json and script files, with an allowlist for fixture files that intentionally contain markers
After PR #850 merges, review the formerly conflicted region (lines 1214-1586 on 15456ec46) for duplicated or contradictory requirement text and fix in a follow-up
Record the gate in docs/specs/README.md or the CI contract with a requirement ID
body: On origin/main as of 2026-10-12 (e.g. 15456ec46), docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md contains literal conflict markers at lines 1214 (<<<<<<< HEAD), 1329 (=======) and 1586 (>>>>>>> origin/main). git log -m -S shows they entered through 0927631ce (Merge remote-tracking branch origin/main into claude/v1-0040-session-test-runner-spec), reached main through c204e9262 and the PR #838 merge 6451002ef. The 12 local doc gates, CI doc-gates and the spec-index/requirements checks all passed with the markers in place, so nothing in the gate set rejects a committed conflict marker in a governed spec. The V1-1278 S1 PR beamfall/corvint#850 removes the three marker lines and keeps both sides (commit 8a1b5361 merge resolution), which is the agreed convention for shared-insertion conflicts in this spec; the content between the markers has not been reviewed for duplicated requirement text. Confirmed by git grep on origin/main.
title: Conflict markers were committed to docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md on main (0927631ce via PR #838) and no gate caught them
